destinationsScraped.name: Ajanta Caves
destinationsScraped.url: https://maharashtratourism.gov.in/cave/ajanta/ (read via in-app browser; WebFetch on the gov site returns navigation-only)
destinationsScraped.summary: ~30 Buddhist rock-cut caves in a horseshoe gorge above the Waghora river, Sahyadri hills, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad) district. Two phases: early group ~2nd-1st c. BCE (Satavahana; caves 9, 10), larger 5th c. CE phase (Vakataka; most of the finest caves + paintings). Types: chaitya-grihas / prayer halls (9, 10, 19, 26) and viharas / monasteries (1, 2, 16, 17). Famed for wall+ceiling murals in natural pigments -- life of the Buddha + Jataka tales; the most important surviving early Indian painting. Forest-covered for centuries; brought to notice 1819 by British officer John Smith on a hunt (his name scratched inside a cave). UNESCO WHS 1983. Site page names nearby: Ellora ~100 km SW, Daulatabad Fort, Bibi ka Maqbara, Aurangabad Caves, Grishneshwar, Lonar Crater Lake. Best Nov-Mar (12-30 C); monsoon lush but harder; summer >40 C; weekdays quieter.
destinationsScraped.access: Air: Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad) ~100 km. Rail: Jalgaon Jn ~60 km (closest), Aurangabad ~100 km. Road: ~100 km/~2.5h from Aurangabad, ~60 km from Jalgaon, ~100 km from Ellora. Private vehicles park at the T-junction ~4 km away; green ASI shuttle buses run the last stretch to the ticket gate.
destinationsScraped.openingNote: Closed Mondays (standard ASI; the gov page doesn't state it but it is well established). Photography without flash allowed inside; no flash/tripod.
destinationsScraped.safetyNotes: Ticketed ASI WHS, guards + licensed guides, controlled shuttle approach, heavy mixed visitor flow. Long walk, many stairs, cliff-side path with drops -- railings, care in wet monsoon. Hot, little shade on the approach -- water/hat/sun cover. Persistent hawkers + unofficial 'guides' at the T-junction -- book a licensed guide at the gate. Do the day trip from Aurangabad in daylight.

destinationsScraped.name: Ellora Caves
destinationsScraped.summary: 34 rock-cut caves along a ~2 km basalt escarpment ~30 km from Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad); excavated ~6th-10th c. CE; Buddhist (12, south), Hindu (17, middle), Jain (5, north) side by side. NEVER lost (unlike Ajanta). Centrepiece: Kailasa Temple (Cave 16) -- a full Dravidian-style Shiva temple cut DOWNWARD from the cliff top, ~200,000 tonnes of rock removed, free-standing temple+courtyard+gateway+elephants+shrines in one piece; the world's largest monolithic rock excavation; attributed to Rashtrakuta king Krishna I, 8th c. Buddhist group incl. the multi-storey Vishvakarma chaitya (Cave 10); Jain Indra Sabha group (30-34) small but finely carved. UNESCO WHS 1983. Grishneshwar Jyotirlinga a short walk away.
destinationsScraped.access: Air/Rail: Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad) ~30-35 km. Road: ~30 km/~45 min from Aurangabad (passes Daulatabad Fort + Bibi ka Maqbara); ~100 km from Ajanta. Main groups walkable together; ~2 km to the Jain caves at the north end (walk or auto).
destinationsScraped.openingNote: Closed Tuesdays (Ajanta closed Mondays) -- plan the two around that. Photography allowed; interiors dim.
destinationsScraped.safetyNotes: ASI WHS, guards, ticketing, licensed guides, large mixed flow. Kailasa = stairs, uneven rock, a climb to the rim with UNPROTECTED edges -- care near drops. Hot/unshaded midday outside winter. Walk/auto to the Jain caves is a quieter stretch -- day only, auto if alone. Hawkers + unofficial guides in the car park -- licensed guide from the ticket office only.
destinationsScraped.govPageError: The maharashtratourism.gov.in Ellora page states Ellora 'dates back to the 6th century' only, and that 'John Smith' rediscovered Ellora -- the latter conflates it with Ajanta (Ellora was never lost). Card uses the well-established ~6th-10th c. range and omits the John-Smith-at-Ellora claim.
